subject: Cognitive Science
title: The Bandwagon Effect
description: A fast breakdown of The Bandwagon Effect for builders.

hook.text: A restaurant with a long line looks better than an empty one—even if the food is the same. You join the line.

buildup.text: The bandwagon effect: we adopt beliefs and behaviors because many others already have.

discovery.text: Solomon Asch showed people deny what their own eyes see to agree with a unanimous wrong group.

twist.text: Social proof works even when faked. Laugh tracks, inflated follower counts, and fake reviews all exploit it.

climax.text: In markets, bandwagons create bubbles. Everyone buys because everyone else is buying—until it pops.

punchline.text: Popular isn't proof. The crowd can be wrong.

quiz.question: What drives the bandwagon effect?
options: Adopting beliefs because many others hold them
